hero.headline: Barista Training and Coffee Courses in Nairobi
hero.lead: Hands-on barista courses for beginners and aspiring professionals, plus customer service training and café consulting.

programs.heading: Barista Courses in Nairobi
programs.intro: Choose a beginner or professional barista course in Nairobi. Train hands-on in coffee preparation and barista skills, or ask about guest experience and customer service training. Intakes are ongoing; contact us for the next available start date.

courses.title: Professional Barista Course
courses.desc: Our full barista program for people who want to work or build a career in coffee.

courses.title: Basic Barista Course
courses.desc: A shorter introduction to coffee and barista skills, ideal for beginners.

courses.title: Guest Experience & Customer Service
courses.desc: Training in welcoming guests and serving customers well. Contact us for duration and fees.

about.heading: More Than a School, It’s a Community
about.image_alt: Two smiling baristas in tan Brew Masters aprons embroidered Barista Wyre and Barista Erick
paragraphs: Brew Masters Coffee Academy is a coffee education and consulting business built around three ideas: train people in the craft of coffee, consult for coffee businesses, and connect everyone who loves coffee.
Whether you are pouring your first espresso or shaping a café menu, you learn by doing, with practical skills you can use the next day.

consulting.heading: Support for Coffee Businesses
consulting.intro: Practical guidance for coffee shops, cafés and coffee entrepreneurs, from the first idea to the daily running of the bar.
consulting.image_alt: A man wiping down an espresso machine beside the Brew Masters banner at an exhibition stand

services.title: Café and menu guidance
services.desc: Shape a coffee offer that suits your customers.

services.title: Equipment and workflow
services.desc: Set up your bar so service is smooth and consistent.

services.title: Team training
services.desc: Build barista skills inside your own business.

services.title: Starting a coffee business
services.desc: Advice for entrepreneurs entering the industry.
